name: Adventure Time: Fionna and Cake
description: Fionna and Cake – with the help of the former Ice King, Simon Petrikov - embark on a multiverse-hopping adventure and journey of self-discovery. All the while a powerful new antagonist determined to track them down and erase them from existence, lurks in the shadows.

videos.title: Fionna Campbell
videos.overview: After a disastrous morning, a down-on-her luck Fionna seeks treatment for an out-of-sorts Cake.

videos.title: Simon Petrikov
videos.overview: Struggling to find his place as a human in a magical world, Simon considers taking desperate measures before embarking on a quest with an old friend.

videos.title: Cake the Cat
videos.overview: While Cake crash-lands in a fantastic new world, Fionna continues her search after witnessing something impossible.

videos.title: Prismo the Wishmaster
videos.overview: Fionna, Cake, and Simon converge in a strange place to discover how they're connected.

videos.title: Destiny
videos.overview: Pursued by a powerful enemy, Fionna, Cake and Simon venture through a lawless world in search of a magical artifact.

videos.title: The Winter King
videos.overview: After landing in the Winter Kingdom, Fionna and Simon discover a possible solution to their problems. Marshall Lee helps Gary with a baking project.

videos.title: The Star
videos.overview: Cake is recruited by a band of skilled vampire hunters. Gary and Marshall Lee attend a black-tie party.

videos.title: Jerry
videos.overview: Stranded in a desolate wasteland, Fionna, Cake and Simon must resort to desperate measures to escape.

videos.title: Casper & Nova
videos.overview: While Simon experiences a cosmic detour, doom closes in on Fionna and Cake.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.overview: Simon battles his demons as Fionna, Cake and friends fight for their world.

videos.title: The Hare and the Sprout
videos.overview: After saving their world, Fionna and Cake try to find where they fit in. Huntress Wizard makes a disturbing discovery and turns to Simon for help.

videos.title: The Crocodile Who Bit a Log
videos.overview: Fionna and Cake attempt to solve a heated debate with force. A desperate Huntress Wizard contends with a secret order of Wizards.

videos.title: The Lion of Embers
videos.overview: A nervous Cake goes on her first date. Fionna revisits an old flame. Huntress Wizard struggles to survive in a magic-free world.

videos.title: The Cat Who Tipped the Box
videos.overview: While Cake explores a career in television, a heartbroken Fionna takes a walk down memory lane, and Huntress Wizard searches for a way home.

videos.title: The Butterfly and the River
videos.overview: Despite several setbacks, Fionna redoubles her efforts to help her friends, while Cake and Huntress explore an enigmatic labyrinth.

videos.title: The Bird in the Clock
videos.overview: During a night of strange visions, Huntress enlists Finn's allies to save him from an impending Croak Dream.

videos.title: The Wolves Who Wandered
videos.overview: After a VIP goes missing, Fionna turns to magic and an unlikely ally for help, while Huntress conducts her own search.

videos.title: The Insect that Sang
videos.overview: When Fionna and Huntress Wizard are taken captive, Cake is left to pull off Boys Night on her own.

videos.title: The Worm and his Orchard
videos.overview: After plunging into the unknown, Fionna, Cake, and Huntress Wizard are forced to confront difficult truths.

videos.title: The Bear and the Rose
videos.overview: As time runs out for a wounded hero, PB turns to science for solutions, while Huntress fights to make her way back to Ooo to stop her. Later, Fionna seeks to undo a disastrous decision.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 2 wins & 3 nominations total
